title: Decision: Strategic Product Pivot for Entire Company
goals: capitalize on emerging market opportunities, ensure long-term company viability, leverage existing technical capabilities, and maximize return on investment

options.title: Enterprise AI Focus
options.description: Pivot from general SaaS tools to specialized AI-powered enterprise solutions, targeting Fortune 500 companies with high-touch sales model

options.title: Vertical Integration
options.description: Transform from horizontal platform to full-stack solution for healthcare sector, including specialized compliance and workflow features

options.title: Developer Infrastructure
options.description: Shift to providing developer-focused APIs and infrastructure, monetizing our core technology as a platform service

options.title: SMB Automation Suite
options.description: Refocus on small/medium business market with integrated automation tools, featuring low-code solutions and self-service options

criteria.title: Market Size

criteria.title: Revenue Impact
criteria.description: Expected changes to revenue model, customer lifetime value, and cash flow

criteria.title: Technical Feasibility
criteria.description: Ability to leverage existing technology and required new development

criteria.title: Customer Transition
criteria.description: Impact on existing customers and migration path for current userbase

criteria.title: Team Alignment
criteria.description: Current team capabilities and required organizational changes

criteria.title: Competition Level
criteria.description: Competitive landscape and barriers to entry in new market

criteria.title: Time to Market
criteria.description: Expected timeline to launch viable product and achieve market fit

criteria.title: Investment Required
criteria.description: Capital needed for product development, marketing, and organizational changes

criteria.title: Risk Profile
criteria.description: Major risks including market acceptance, technical challenges, and regulatory concerns
